reason: Independent PASS2 confirms a current Belgian professional second-hand apparel operator. Oxfam's current official Antwerp Brederode shop page identifies a live Oxfam Tweedehands store selling clothing, shoes and unique retro/vintage pieces, provides an @oxfamsol.be contact, and the same official site identifies Oxfam-Solidariteit VAT BE0408.643.875. Oxfam's July 2026 privacy policy separately lists Oxfam Solidarité as enterprise 0408.643.875, distinct from Oxfam België, Oxfam Wereldwinkels and Oxfam Fair Trade. Current official pages state that Oxfam has about 30 second-hand shops in Belgium and that most sell clothing. No current item-level remote second-hand apparel catalogue or ordinary delivery of those used garments to Spain was established for Oxfam Solidariteit, so the operator is VERIFIED_HOLD rather than ELIGIBLE.
